# Setup
source("code/CSIRO_colours.R")

library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

Load data

data_no_multi <- read.csv("data/preprocessed_with_SA_info_no_multi.csv") %>%
  filter(YOT >= 2014 & YOT <= 2024)

data_with_multi <- read.csv("data/preprocessed_with_SA_info.csv") %>%
  filter(YOT >= 2014 & YOT <= 2024)
sa3_cases_pop <- read.csv("data/SA3_cases_data.csv")

Rank regions

# Rank SA3 regions by cumulative positive cases (2014-2024)
case_concentration_analysis <- sa3_cases_pop %>%
  # Removing SA3s with very low populations and over inflated rates
  filter(
    SA_name != "Canberra East",
    SA_name != "Norfolk Island"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(c1MPPY)) %>%
  arrange(desc(c1MPPY)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    cumulative_cases = cumsum(c1MPPY),
    total_cases = sum(c1MPPY, na.rm = TRUE),
    cumulative_percentage = (cumulative_cases / total_cases) * 100,
    regions_percentage = (rank / n()) * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SA_name,
    rank,
    c1MPPY,
    cumulative_cases,
    cumulative_percentage,
    regions_percentage
  )
# Find key percentile thresholds
percentile_thresholds <- tibble(
  percentile = c(25, 50, 75, 90, 95),
  threshold_cases = map_dbl(
    percentile,
    ~ {
      case_concentration_analysis %>%
        filter(cumulative_percentage >= .x) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1) %>%
        pull(cumulative_cases)
    }
  ),
  regions_needed = map_dbl(
    percentile,
    ~ {
      case_concentration_analysis %>%
        filter(cumulative_percentage >= .x) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1) %>%
        pull(rank)
    }
  ),
  percent_of_regions = map_dbl(
    percentile,
    ~ {
      case_concentration_analysis %>%
        filter(cumulative_percentage >= .x) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1) %>%
        pull(regions_percentage)
    }
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    total_regions = nrow(case_concentration_analysis),
    summary = paste0(
      percentile,
      "% of cases occur in the top ",
      regions_needed,
      " regions (",
      round(percent_of_regions, 1),
      "% of all regions)"
    )
  )
# Display the results
cat("=== CASE CONCENTRATION ANALYSIS ===\n")
print(
  percentile_thresholds %>%
    dplyr::select(percentile, regions_needed, percent_of_regions, summary)
)

Gini Coefficient

# Gini coefficient calculation with bootstrap CI
library(boot)

# Function to calculate Gini coefficient for bootstrap
gini_boot <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]

  gini_calc <- d %>%
    arrange(c1MPPY) %>%
    mutate(
      cumsum_cases = cumsum(c1MPPY),
      cumsum_prop = cumsum_cases / sum(c1MPPY),
      prop_regions = row_number() / n()
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      lorenz_area = sum(
        (prop_regions - lag(prop_regions, default = 0)) *
          (cumsum_prop + lag(cumsum_prop, default = 0)) /
          2
      ),
      gini = (0.5 - lorenz_area) / 0.5
    ) %>%
    pull(gini)

  return(gini_calc)
}

# Run bootstrap
set.seed(7990)
gini_boot_result <- boot(
  data = case_concentration_analysis,
  statistic = gini_boot,
  R = 10000
)

# Calculate 95% CI
gini_ci <- boot.ci(gini_boot_result, type = "bca")

cat("\n=== GINI COEFFICIENT WITH 95% CI ===\n")
cat("Gini Coefficient:", round(gini_boot_result$t0, 3), "\n")
cat(
  "95% CI: [",
  round(gini_ci$bca[4], 3),
  ", ",
  round(gini_ci$bca[5], 3),
  "]\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat("SE:", round(sd(gini_boot_result$t), 4), "\n")

=== GINI COEFFICIENT WITH 95% CI ===
Gini Coefficient: 0.866 
95% CI: [0.837, 0.894]
SE: 0.0159

Spatial autocorrelation (Moran’s I)

library(spdep)

sa3 <- st_read("data/SA3_case_data.shp")

# Calculate case rates for spatial analysis
sa3_with_rates <- sa3_cases_pop %>%
  filter(!is.na(c1MPPY), c1MPPY > 0) %>%
  left_join(
    sa3 %>% dplyr::select(SA_code),
    by = "SA_code"
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Create spatial weights matrix (neighbors)
sa3_neighbors <- poly2nb(sa3_with_rates, queen = TRUE)
sa3_weights <- nb2listw(sa3_neighbors, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Calculate Moran's I
morans_i <- moran.test(sa3_with_rates$c1MPPY, sa3_weights, zero.policy = TRUE)

cat("=== MORAN'S I SPATIAL AUTOCORRELATION ===\n")
print(morans_i)
cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat("  Moran's I =", round(morans_i$estimate[1], 3), "\n")
cat("  Expected I =", round(morans_i$estimate[2], 3), "\n")
cat("  p-value =", format.pval(morans_i$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
cat(
  "  ",
  ifelse(
    morans_i$p.value < 0.05 & morans_i$estimate[1] > 0,
    "Significant positive spatial clustering detected",
    "No significant spatial clustering"
  ),
  "\n"
)

Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA) / Getis-Ord Gi

# Calculate local Moran's I (LISA)
local_morans <- localmoran(
  sa3_with_rates$c1MPPY,
  sa3_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Add to spatial data
sa3_with_rates$local_morans_i <- local_morans[, 1]
sa3_with_rates$local_p_value <- local_morans[, 5]

# Classify regions as hot spots, cold spots, or not significant
sa3_with_rates <- sa3_with_rates %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_type = case_when(
      local_p_value >= 0.05 ~ "Not Significant",
      local_morans_i > 0 &
        c1MPPY > mean(c1MPPY, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "High-High (Hot Spot)",
      local_morans_i > 0 &
        c1MPPY < mean(c1MPPY, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Low-Low (Cold Spot)",
      local_morans_i < 0 &
        c1MPPY > mean(c1MPPY, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "High-Low (Outlier)",
      TRUE ~ "Low-High (Outlier)"
    )
  )

# Calculate Getis-Ord Gi* (alternative hot spot statistic)
getis_ord <- localG(sa3_with_rates$c1MPPY, sa3_weights, zero.policy = TRUE)
sa3_with_rates$gi_star <- as.numeric(getis_ord)
sa3_with_rates$gi_hotspot <- ifelse(
  abs(sa3_with_rates$gi_star) > 1.96,
  "Hot/Cold Spot",
  "Not Significant"
)

cat("\n=== HOT SPOT SUMMARY ===\n")
table(sa3_with_rates$cluster_type)
table(sa3_with_rates$gi_hotspot)

=== HOT SPOT SUMMARY ===

High-High (Hot Spot)   Low-High (Outlier)      Not Significant 
                   8                   19                  184 

  Hot/Cold Spot Not Significant 
             18             184 
# Get centroids of high-case regions
high_case_regions <- sa3_with_rates %>%
  filter(c1MPPY > quantile(c1MPPY, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  st_centroid()

# Calculate distance matrix
dist_matrix <- st_distance(high_case_regions)

# Calculate mean nearest neighbor distance
nearest_neighbor_dist <- apply(
  as.matrix(dist_matrix),
  1,
  function(x) min(x[x > 0])
)

cat("\n=== NEAREST NEIGHBOR ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat(
  "Mean distance between high-case regions:",
  round(mean(nearest_neighbor_dist) / 1000, 1),
  "km\n"
)
cat("Median distance:", round(median(nearest_neighbor_dist) / 1000, 1), "km\n")

Do refering clinicials drive case clustering?

Import and wrangle data

data <- data_no_multi %>%
  filter(Provider != 'DHM') # DHM data does not have ref pc

Analyse ref_pc sa2 clustering

# Convert postcodes to SA2 regions
# Enables population adjusting

pc_2_sa2 <- read.csv("ABS_shapefiles/postcodes_to_SA/postcodes_2_SA2.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(postcode, SA2_code, SA2_name, SA3_code, SA3_name) %>%
  mutate(postcode = as.integer(postcode))

# Ref pc to sa2
data_no_multi_sa2 <- data_no_multi %>%
  left_join(
    pc_2_sa2,
    by = c("ref_pc" = "postcode")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    ref_SA2_code = SA2_code,
    ref_SA2_name = SA2_name,
    #ref_SA3_code = SA3_code,
    #ref_SA3_name = SA3_name
  ) %>%
  mutate(postcode = as.integer(postcode))

# Pat pc to sa2
data_no_multi_sa2 <- data_no_multi_sa2 %>%
  left_join(
    pc_2_sa2,
    by = c("postcode" = "postcode")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    pat_SA2_code = SA2_code,
    pat_SA2_name = SA2_name,
    pat_SA3_code = SA3_code,
    pat_SA3_name = SA3_name
  )

Sum pop adj patients and refferals per sa2

pat sa2

## SA2
# Cumulative number of people tested
cum_pat_tes_sa2 <- data_no_multi_sa2 %>%
  group_by(pat_SA2_name) %>%
  summarise(cum_pat_tes_sa2 = n_distinct(pat_ID), .groups = "drop")

# Cumulative number of positives
cum_pat_pos_sa2 <- data_no_multi_sa2 %>%
  filter(Status == "Positive") %>%
  group_by(pat_SA2_name) %>%
  summarise(cum_pat_pos_sa2 = n_distinct(pat_ID), .groups = "drop")

ref sa2

## SA2
# Cumulative number of people tested
cum_ref_tes_sa2 <- data_no_multi_sa2 %>%
  group_by(ref_SA2_name) %>%
  summarise(cum_ref_tes_sa2 = n_distinct(pat_ID), .groups = "drop")

# Cumulative number of positives
cum_ref_pos_sa2 <- data_no_multi_sa2 %>%
  filter(Status == "Positive") %>%
  group_by(ref_SA2_name) %>%
  summarise(cum_ref_pos_sa2 = n_distinct(pat_ID), .groups = "drop")
sa2_sum <- cum_pat_tes_sa2 %>%
  full_join(cum_pat_pos_sa2, by = "pat_SA2_name") %>%
  full_join(cum_ref_tes_sa2, by = c("pat_SA2_name" = "ref_SA2_name")) %>%
  full_join(cum_ref_pos_sa2, by = c("pat_SA2_name" = "ref_SA2_name")) %>%
  rename(SA2_name = pat_SA2_name)

Case concentration of re sa2

ref_pc_cases <- data_no_multi %>%
  filter(Provider != "DHM") %>%
  group_by(ref_pc) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests = n(),
    n_pos = sum(Status == "Positive", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_pos)) %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative_tests = cumsum(n_tests),
    cumulative_tests_pct = cumulative_tests / sum(n_tests) * 100,
    rank_tests = row_number(),
    #
    cumulative_pos = cumsum(n_pos),
    cumulative_pos_pct = cumulative_pos / sum(n_pos) * 100,
    rank_pos = row_number()
  )

Moran’s I

select <- dplyr::select
sa2_sf <- read_sf(
  "ABS_shapefiles/SA2_2021_AUST_SHP_GDA2020/SA2_2021_AUST_GDA2020.shp"
)
# Prepare spatial data for referring SA2 regions
# Join sa2_sum (which contains referring statistics) with sa2_sf (spatial features)
ref_sa2_spatial <- sa2_sum %>%
  filter(!is.na(R_c1MPPY), R_c1MPPY > 0, cum_ref_pos_sa2 > 0) %>%
  mutate(SA2_code = as.character(SA2_code)) %>%
  # Join with spatial features - check column names in sa2_sf (typically SA2_CODE21 or SA2_CODE_2021)
  left_join(
    sa2_sf %>% select(SA2_CODE21, SA2_NAME21, geometry),
    by = c("SA2_code" = "SA2_CODE21")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(geometry)) %>% # Remove SA2s without spatial match
  st_as_sf()

# Check how many SA2 regions we have
cat("Number of SA2 regions with referring data:", nrow(ref_sa2_spatial), "\n")

# Calculate global Moran's I for REFERRING SA2 regions
# Using R_c1MPPY (referring positive cases per million per year)
# Check for regions with no neighbors
no_neighbors <- card(ref_neighbors)
isolated_regions <- which(no_neighbors == 0)

cat("Number of isolated regions:", length(isolated_regions), "\n")

if (length(isolated_regions) > 0) {
  cat("Removing", length(isolated_regions), "isolated regions\n")

  # Remove isolated regions
  ref_sa2_spatial_clean <- ref_sa2_spatial[-isolated_regions, ]

  # Recreate spatial weights
  ref_neighbors_clean <- poly2nb(ref_sa2_spatial_clean, queen = TRUE)
  ref_weights_clean <- nb2listw(
    ref_neighbors_clean,
    style = "W",
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )

  # Recalculate Moran's I
  morans_ref <- moran.test(
    ref_sa2_spatial_clean$R_c1MPPY,
    ref_weights_clean,
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )

  cat("\nREFERRING SA2 Moran's I Analysis (cleaned):\n")
  cat("  Moran's I =", round(morans_ref$estimate[1], 3), "\n")
  cat("  Expected I =", round(morans_ref$estimate[2], 3), "\n")
  cat("  Variance =", round(morans_ref$estimate[3], 6), "\n")
  cat("  p-value =", format.pval(morans_ref$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
}
cat(
  "  Interpretation:",
  ifelse(
    morans_ref$p.value < 0.05 & morans_ref$estimate[1] > 0,
    "Significant positive spatial clustering",
    ifelse(
      morans_ref$p.value < 0.05 & morans_ref$estimate[1] < 0,
      "Significant negative spatial clustering (dispersion)",
      "No significant spatial clustering"
    )
  ),
  "\n"
)

# Calculate Moran's I for PATIENT SA2 regions (for this specific subset of data)
# This is important because this dataset only includes records with referring clinician postcodes
pat_sa2_spatial <- sa2_sum %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_c1MPPY), P_c1MPPY > 0, cum_pat_pos_sa2 > 0) %>%
  filter(is.finite(P_c1MPPY)) %>% # Add this line to remove Inf/-Inf
  mutate(SA2_code = as.character(SA2_code)) %>%
  left_join(
    sa2_sf %>% select(SA2_CODE21, SA2_NAME21, geometry),
    by = c("SA2_code" = "SA2_CODE21")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(geometry)) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Create spatial weights for patient SA2
pat_neighbors <- poly2nb(pat_sa2_spatial, queen = TRUE)
pat_weights <- nb2listw(pat_neighbors, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Calculate Moran's I for patient data
morans_pat <- moran.test(
  pat_sa2_spatial$P_c1MPPY,
  pat_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

cat("\nPATIENT SA2 Moran's I Analysis (for this subset):\n")
cat("  Moran's I =", round(morans_pat$estimate[1], 3), "\n")
cat("  Expected I =", round(morans_pat$estimate[2], 3), "\n")
cat("  p-value =", format.pval(morans_pat$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
cat(
  "  Interpretation:",
  ifelse(
    morans_pat$p.value < 0.05 & morans_pat$estimate[1] > 0,
    "Significant positive spatial clustering",
    "No significant spatial clustering"
  ),
  "\n"
)

# Comparison and epidemiological interpretation
cat("\n==========================================\n")
cat("=== SPATIAL AUTOCORRELATION COMPARISON ===\n")
cat("==========================================\n\n")

cat("Patient SA2 Moran's I:", round(morans_pat$estimate[1], 3), "\n")
cat("Referring SA2 Moran's I:", round(morans_ref$estimate[1], 3), "\n\n")

# Calculate ratio
ratio <- morans_ref$estimate[1] / morans_pat$estimate[1]
cat("Ratio (Referring/Patient):", round(ratio, 3), "\n\n")

# Epidemiological interpretation
cat("=== EPIDEMIOLOGICAL INTERPRETATION ===\n\n")

if (morans_pat$p.value >= 0.05) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: Patient SA2 clustering is not statistically significant.\n")
  cat("   Cannot draw strong conclusions about clinician effect.\n\n")
} else if (morans_ref$p.value >= 0.05) {
  cat("✓ STRONG EVIDENCE FOR CLINICIAN EFFECT:\n")
  cat(
    "   - Patient SA2s show significant clustering (Moran's I = ",
    round(morans_pat$estimate[1], 3),
    ")\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "   - Referring SA2s show NO significant clustering (p = ",
    round(morans_ref$p.value, 3),
    ")\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat("   - This suggests case clustering is driven by healthcare provider\n")
  cat(
    "     knowledge/behavior rather than true geographic disease prevalence.\n\n"
  )
} else if (ratio < 0.7) {
  cat("✓ MODERATE EVIDENCE FOR CLINICIAN EFFECT:\n")
  cat(
    "   - Referring SA2 clustering is substantially lower than patient clustering\n"
  )
  cat(
    "   - Ratio of ",
    round(ratio, 2),
    " suggests clinicians are geographically dispersed\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "   - This pattern is consistent with specific high-knowledge providers\n"
  )
  cat("     diagnosing cases across broader geographic areas.\n\n")
} else if (ratio > 1.3) {
  cat("✗ HYPOTHESIS NOT SUPPORTED:\n")
  cat(
    "   - Referring SA2 clustering is equal to or higher than patient clustering\n"
  )
  cat("   - This suggests true geographic disease prevalence rather than\n")
  cat("     clinician-driven detection bias.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("? MIXED EVIDENCE:\n")
  cat("   - Similar clustering levels between patient and referring SA2s\n")
  cat(
    "   - Ratio of ",
    round(ratio, 2),
    " suggests both geographic disease prevalence\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat("     and clinician factors may contribute to observed patterns.\n")
  cat("   - Further investigation needed (see ANALYSIS 3-5).\n\n")
}

# Calculate distances between patient and clinician postcode centroids
calc_distance_sa2 <- function(pat_pc, ref_pc, centroids) {
  # If same postcode, distance is 0
  if (pat_pc == ref_pc) {
    return(0)
  }

  # Find centroids for both postcodes
  pat_pt <- centroids %>% filter(postcode == pat_pc)
  ref_pt <- centroids %>% filter(postcode == ref_pc)

  # If either postcode not found, return NA
  if (nrow(pat_pt) == 0 | nrow(ref_pt) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  }

  # Calculate distance in km
  dist <- st_distance(pat_pt, ref_pt)[1, 1]
  return(as.numeric(dist) / 1000) # Convert meters to km
}

# Calculate Getis-Ord Gi* statistic for referring SA2 regions
# This identifies hot spots (clusters of high values) and cold spots (clusters of low values)
getis_ord_ref <- localG(
  ref_sa2_spatial$R_c1MPPY,
  ref_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Add Gi* scores to the spatial dataframe
ref_sa2_spatial$gi_star <- as.numeric(getis_ord_ref)

# Classify hot spots and cold spots (using 95% confidence level, z > 1.96)
ref_sa2_spatial$gi_classification <- case_when(
  ref_sa2_spatial$gi_star > 1.96 ~ "Hot Spot (High)",
  ref_sa2_spatial$gi_star < -1.96 ~ "Cold Spot (Low)",
  TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
)

# Summary of hot/cold spots
gi_summary <- table(ref_sa2_spatial$gi_classification)
cat("Getis-Ord Gi* Classification:\n")
print(gi_summary)

# Identify potential high-knowledge referring regions
# Criteria: Either high rate (>2x median) OR significant hot spot
median_rate_ref <- median(ref_sa2_spatial$R_c1MPPY, na.rm = TRUE)
high_threshold <- 2 * median_rate_ref

high_knowledge_regions <- ref_sa2_spatial %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    R_c1MPPY > high_threshold | # More than 2x median rate
      gi_star > 1.96 # Significant hot spot (95% confidence)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(R_c1MPPY)) %>%
  select(SA2_name, SA2_code, cum_ref_pos_sa2, R_c1MPPY, gi_star, gi_classification)

# Identify SA2 regions that act as referral hubs
# Hubs are defined as regions where clinicians receive many cases from OTHER SA2 regions
referral_hubs <- data_no_multi_sa2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(pat_SA2_code), !is.na(ref_SA2_code)) %>%
  group_by(ref_SA2_code, ref_SA2_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cases = n(),
    local_cases = sum(pat_SA2_code == ref_SA2_code),
    remote_cases = sum(pat_SA2_code != ref_SA2_code),
    pct_remote = mean(pat_SA2_code != ref_SA2_code) * 100,
    n_different_patient_SA2s = n_distinct(pat_SA2_code[
      pat_SA2_code != ref_SA2_code
    ]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_cases >= 5) %>% # Minimum threshold (lower for SA2 vs SA3)
  arrange(desc(pct_remote))

  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median(distances$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    size = 1
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = median(distances$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE) + 50,
    y = Inf,
    label = paste0(
      "Median: ",
      round(median(distances$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      " km"
    ),
    color = "red",
    vjust = 2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic Distance: Patient SA2 to Referring Clinician SA2",
    subtitle = "Distribution shows how far patients travel for consultation",
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Number of cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40")
  ) +
  xlim(0, 500)

print(distance_plot)
# Save plot
ggsave(
  "plots/distance_distribution_sa2.png",
  distance_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
# PLOT 2: Concentration curves comparing patient vs referring SA2 regions
# Prepare referring SA2 concentration data
ref_concentration <- ref_sa2_spatial %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  arrange(desc(cum_ref_pos_sa2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    cumulative_pct = cumsum(cum_ref_pos_sa2) / sum(cum_ref_pos_sa2) * 100,
    type = "Referring SA2"
  ) %>%
  select(rank, cumulative_pct, type)

# Prepare patient SA2 concentration data
patient_concentration <- pat_sa2_spatial %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  arrange(desc(cum_pat_pos_sa2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    cumulative_pct = cumsum(cum_pat_pos_sa2) / sum(cum_pat_pos_sa2) * 100,
    type = "Patient SA2"
  ) %>%
  select(rank, cumulative_pct, type)

# Combine data
concentration_data <- bind_rows(ref_concentration, patient_concentration)

# Create plot
concentration_plot <- ggplot(
  concentration_data,
  aes(x = rank, y = cumulative_pct, color = type, linetype = type)
) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 90,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Patient SA2" = "#E41A1C", "Referring SA2" = "#377EB8")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Patient SA2" = "solid", "Referring SA2" = "dashed")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Case Concentration: Patient vs Referring SA2 Regions",
    subtitle = "Cumulative percentage of positive cases by region rank",
    x = "Rank (regions ordered by number of positive cases)",
    y = "Cumulative % of positive cases",
    color = "Region Type",
    linetype = "Region Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(concentration_plot)
# Save plot
ggsave(
  "plots/concentration_curves_sa2.png",
  concentration_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
